name: Conrad Pune
positioning: Hilton's Conrad hotel in the Central Business District of Pune, with a rooftop bar, an outdoor temperature-controlled pool and a full wellbeing floor
best_for: Travelers who want a city base in Pune's Central Business District
Guests who want a spa, salon, pools and a round-the-clock gym in one hotel

facts.text: Conrad Pune is in the Central Business District in Koregaon, Pune.
The airport is 7 kilometres from the hotel.
Each room is decorated with art pieces and collectives.
The Deluxe Room - King has an in-room espresso machine.
The pool extends to the Kabana, a western lounge.
The hotel has a kids' pool.
The Conrad Spa has four treatment rooms and a couple's room.
Each wellbeing changing room has a sauna and a steam room.
The changing-room showers have Diptyque bathroom amenities.
The Conrad Salon has professional hair stylists and beauty therapists.
The fitness facility is open around the clock.
Koji serves the flavours of Japan, China and Thailand.

highlights.text: The hotel has Pune's first outdoor temperature-controlled swimming pool, with a built-in whirlpool.
Al Di La is an outdoor rooftop bar 72 metres above ground level with views of Pune.
Spa treatments range from Ayurvedic treatments to Western therapies.
The Deluxe Room - King has city views through floor-to-ceiling windows.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the urban location may not suit guests seeking a resort-style experience.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
